headline: Tax office: More than 155,000 professionals expected to pay less tax in 2027
summary: Changes to presumed income and the tax scale are expected to reduce the tax burden for more than 155,000 professionals on 2026 income. Families with children are also set to receive reductions.
why: Tax changes alter household disposable income and government revenue, which matter for consumption and fiscal forecasts in Greece.
